text:
Situation: Imipenem and cilastatin 500 mg vials at Corvale East are at 66 on hand, providing 4 days of supply at 16.5 vials per day. Corvale General holds 472 vials (29.5 days) and Corvale Lakeside holds 105 vials (29.8 days). The drug is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include imipenem and cilastatin as of 2026-10-21. FDA status is listed as To Be Discontinued since an unspecified date.

Our position: Internal redistribution can resolve the East campus shortfall without external purchase. Lakeside can spare 55 vials and retain 14 days of supply; East would reach 7 days. General can spare 166 vials and retain 14 days; East would reach 14 days. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC is not on the FDA shortage list and its label does not identify a manufacturing plant for verification.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 55 vials from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. If additional supply is needed, transfer 166 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
3. If transfers are insufficient, initiate purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — requires buyer execution.

Not recommended: No external purchase at this time; internal stock is adequate to cover the gap.
